reason: The B layer is the one lever with a recorded effect: A arms failed six expr checks, both B arms failed exactly one (ErrtypeTypeError), and the class-grouping rewrite of rev-2 changed nothing. The surviving check is a behavior on a value the new construct never creates itself - errtype() must classify a panic raised by another implementation, and the already-closed family required string(err) to render as the bare message for a value handed in from outside. B-rev3 therefore keeps the self-check but states the value space explicitly: exercise the new behavior on values from other code, empty and nil values, non-string values, error paths, panics and repeated calls, and behave exactly as the rest of the project does. Same five cells, same composition, single delta (the B prefix text).
